title: Yellow Citrusy Peruvian Uni Lomo Saltado
description: A citrusy and light Peruvian dish featuring uni, this ovo-vegetarian friendly meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner, made in a copper pot and broiled to perfection.

ingredients.name: lomo saltado beef strips
ingredients.notes: replace with portobello mushrooms for vegetarian option

instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a copper pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lomo saltado beef strips and cook until browned.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yellow citrus juice and beaten egg.
Pour the citrus egg mixture over the beef mixture and stir to combine.
Add the uni and stir gently to combine.
Transfer the copper pot to the broiler and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
